question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Who'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option is:** 'Who'**
 
• In this context, **'who'** is used as a relative pronoun to introduce a relative clause.
 
• It is **specifically used **for people (in this case, 'kids').

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The study, published today in a magazine, finds that kids **'who** played only individual sports, like tennis or gymnastics, tended to (2)______ more mental health difficulties. As a researcher, Hoffmann has long been interested in how sports (3)______ the psychological health of young people, partly because studies have (4)_______ both positive and negative associations between mental health and sports (5)______ in children and adolescents.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **That - **This can be used as a relative pronoun but it is generally used for things, not people.
 
• **Which - **This is also used as a relative pronoun but it is usually used for things or animals, not people.
 
• **Whose -** This is a possessive relative pronoun, used to show possession. It does not fit in this context.
